hypothesis.causal_change: A representation-only canonicalization precedes the sole cross-component performance transformation in one nonbranching lineage.
hypothesis.expected_effect: The final transformation should remain coherent across components while preserving interface and state obligations.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsified unless the emitted policy artifact is all-valid and satisfies the median promotion contract.
hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Representational entanglement can make one performance-bearing transformation difficult to isolate and validate.

structure.information_flow: One nonbranching executable lineage: anchor_policy to semantic_normalizer_policy to strength_transducer_policy. The first call changes representation only; the second performs the sole performance-bearing transformation and emits the final policy artifact.
structure.name: Single-Lineage Semantic Transduction

calls.objective: Transform exactly one supplied anchor policy into exactly one complete runnable canonical policy artifact. Expose interface handling, valid eviction-key production, cache-state update and reversal, key indexing, repeated-access state, objective-accounting state, and eviction-decision state through explicit single-source transitions. Use bounded in-call executable equivalence and invariant probes, repairing only this transduction until consistent. Preserve the anchor's replacement behavior and objective intent; do not introduce performance changes, alternative implementations, candidate variants, or selection.

Consume the sole canonical policy and emit exactly one complete production-ready policy artifact. Diagnose one highest-leverage decision weakness using the supplied task, anchor contract, task constraints, and bounded evidence; realize one coherent cross-component improvement through the canonical seams; and run bounded eviction-validity, interface, state-integrity, and request-pattern sanity checks. Repair the same unfinished transformation in place if a check fails. Do not generate alternatives, compare candidate variants, reproduce the anchor workflow, invoke an external verifier, attribute exact source deltas, or perform preserve-versus-rollback selection.
